feeds.title: Mermaid Cottages Blog
feeds.description: Vintage Cottage Rentals, mostly pet friendly. Coastal gardens and picket fences, screened porches and miles of beaches and salt marsh. We've gathered together a collection of vacation homes each one special and unique. Our Vintage homes are fresh and clean and welcome you with open arms.

feeds.title: Beach Life Bliss
feeds.description: I am a work from home IT professional, doggie mom of 2, foodie that loves to cook, adventure travel seeker, living in South East Florida trying to soak up every ounce of sunshine and life! I decided to start this blog to hopefully share some of my favorite things about simple life at the beach and how it is the best!

feeds.title: Beach House Arvi Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Beach House Arvi Blog and get to know about the experience of living in a luxurious beach home in Greece. Blending simplicity & luxury in a stunning environment, Beach House Arvi brings you the best of Crete.

feeds.title: Sea Cottages of Amelia
feeds.description: Sea Cottages of Amelia offers unique accommodations in a natural setting in Amelia Island in Fernandina Beach - the jewel of north Florida. Sea Cottages of Amelia offers a unique stay in a natural setting under a majestic tree canopy. Our suites, just minutes from the beach, offer all the comforts of home.

feeds.title: The Aqua Cottage Blog
feeds.description: Welcome To The Aqua Cottage Where We Dream In Colors Borrowed From The Sea. Find advice on decoration and lifestyle on our blog. The Aqua Cottage is about helping you create a gorgeous, relaxing, stress free home and life! We will share great food recipes, interior design ideas, practical advice, and some of my favorite coastal home decor ideas.

feeds.title: Florida Beach Rentals Blog
feeds.description: Florida Beach Rentals provides vacation rental reservations along the Central Gulf Coast ranging from houses and condos to even motels and resorts. With an inventory of over 500 units, we are sure to find you the perfect place to stay on your next Florida vacation.

feeds.title: Beach Cottage Living Cape Cod Blog
feeds.description: The Beach Cottage Living Cape Cod Blog provides you with fun recipes for baking delicious and healthy treats as well as other interesting ideas. Beach Cottage Living 'unofficially' started 26 years ago when my oldest son was born. I was making rag rugs and pillows for a little extra cash and selling in local Cape Cod shops and doing craft shows. I currently have my own Pop Up space in West Barnstable and a creative studio space in the former Harwich Middle School to create, design, sew and paint.

feeds.title: Lakelovers Blog
feeds.description: A family-run company offering 400 Self Catering Cottages in the Lake District. New cottages wanted throughout the U.K. Guide to lake district holidays. Let Lakes Cottage Holidays plan your next Lake District Holiday our cottage collection find the perfect kind of cottage for your Lake District holiday.

feeds.title: Kristy Seibert Designs Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kristy. As a professional interior designer for over 20 years, I hope that this blog will inspire you with fabulous coastal style decorating and DIY ideas. Subscribe to get weekly decorating tips and seasonal updates to the cottage.

feeds.title: Seabrook Washington Blog
feeds.description: The Seabrook blog keeps you up to date on everything that is happening within the Seabrook community, as well as activities and events to enjoy on your Washington Coast vacation. Seabrook is a vibrant beach town located on the rugged Washington Coast overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
